data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons and donate the full $15,000, provided John, Kate, and Jack each make the same commitment and Luke takes zero. My family taught me to protect this lake, but our neighbors need treatment today. This must be a coordinated exception—not permission for anyone to take extra. I’ll also commit to six tons next month under the proposed 30-ton recovery cap. Let’s share the donation receipts afterward so everyone can see the clinic received the full amount. John, are you in?
